C0657.title: Trojan Implanted in E-Commerce Cloud Warehouses to Steal Express Parcel Label Data
C0657.summary: Starting November 2021, a criminal group implanted trojan software in over 100 e-commerce cloud warehouses across Zhejiang, Guangdong, and other regions, illegally stealing over 5 million express parcel label records. The data was sold through intermediaries or directly to fraud groups and used in precision fraud and related black-market activity, with the total amount involved reaching approximately 30 million yuan. The case was cracked by Yuyao police in Ningbo, who arrested 35 criminal suspects.
